settings.name: USE_REDIS
settings.description: **Enable Redis:** Set to `yes` to enable Redis/Valkey integration for cluster mode.

settings.name: REDIS_HOST
settings.description: **Redis/Valkey Server:** IP address or hostname of the Redis/Valkey server. Not required when `REDIS_SENTINEL_HOSTS` is set (the master is resolved through the Sentinels).

settings.name: REDIS_PORT
settings.description: **Redis/Valkey Port:** Port number of the Redis/Valkey server.

settings.name: REDIS_DATABASE
settings.description: **Redis/Valkey Database:** Database number to use on the Redis/Valkey server (0-15).

settings.name: REDIS_SSL
settings.description: **Redis/Valkey SSL:** Set to `yes` to enable SSL/TLS encryption for the Redis/Valkey connection.

settings.name: REDIS_SSL_VERIFY
settings.description: **Redis/Valkey SSL Verify:** Set to `yes` to verify the Redis/Valkey server's SSL certificate.

settings.name: REDIS_TIMEOUT
settings.description: **Redis/Valkey Timeout:** Connect/read/write timeout in milliseconds for Redis/Valkey operations. Accepts a time suffix (ms, s, m, h, d, w, M, y); a bare number is milliseconds.

settings.name: REDIS_CLUSTER_NODES
settings.description: **Cluster Nodes:** Seed nodes of a Redis Cluster, `host[:port]` separated by spaces, `[ipv6]:port` for IPv6. Enables cluster mode.

settings.name: REDIS_SENTINEL_HOSTS
settings.description: **Sentinel Hosts:** Space-separated list of Redis Sentinel hosts (hostname:port).

settings.name: REDIS_SENTINEL_USERNAME
settings.description: **Sentinel Username:** Username for Redis Sentinel authentication.

settings.name: REDIS_SENTINEL_PASSWORD
settings.description: **Sentinel Password:** Password for Redis Sentinel authentication.

settings.name: REDIS_SENTINEL_MASTER
settings.description: **Sentinel Master:** Name of the master in Redis Sentinel configuration.

settings.name: REDIS_KEEPALIVE_IDLE
settings.description: **Keepalive Idle:** Maximum idle time (in milliseconds) before closing a pooled Redis/Valkey connection. Accepts a time suffix (ms, s, m, h, d, w, M, y); a bare number is milliseconds.

settings.name: REDIS_KEEPALIVE_POOL
settings.description: **Keepalive Pool:** Maximum number of Redis/Valkey connections kept in the pool, per NGINX worker.
